title: teslalog: Efficiency
description: Port of TeslaMate's Efficiency dashboard. Net consumption counts only range lost while driving; gross also counts range lost while parked. Both follow the Range type (rated/ideal) setting.

targets.queryText:
SELECT SUM((d.$start_range - d.$end_range) * v.efficiency_wh_km)
       / NULLIF(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (SUM(d.distance_km)) / 1.60934 ELSE (SUM(d.distance_km)) END, 0) AS value
FROM drives d JOIN vehicles v ON v.id = d.vehicle_id
WHERE d.status = 'closed'
  AND d.distance_km IS NOT NULL
  AND d.$start_range - d.$end_range >= 0.1
  AND d.start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

targets.queryText:
SELECT (
WITH events AS (
  SELECT 'drive_start' AS event, start_time AS time, $start_range AS range FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'drive_end', COALESCE(end_time, start_time), $end_range FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_start', start_time, $start_range FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_end', COALESCE(end_time, start_time), $end_range FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
), ordered AS (
  SELECT event, range, LEAD(range) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS next_range FROM events WHERE range IS NOT NULL
), losses AS (
  SELECT CASE
           WHEN event = 'drive_start' THEN range - next_range
           WHEN range - next_range > 0 THEN range - next_range
           ELSE 0
         END AS loss
  FROM ordered WHERE next_range IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(loss), 0) * (SELECT efficiency_wh_km FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) FROM losses) / NULLIF((SELECT CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (SUM(distance_km)) / 1.60934 ELSE (SUM(distance_km)) END FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')), 0) AS value

targets.queryText:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'C'
              THEN ROUND(d.outside_temp_avg_c / 5.0) * 5
              ELSE ROUND((d.outside_temp_avg_c * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32) / 10.0) * 10
         END AS bucket,
         SUM(d.$start_range - d.$end_range) AS total_range,
         SUM(d.distance_km) AS total_distance,
         SUM(d.duration_min) AS duration
  FROM drives d
  WHERE d.status = 'closed'
    AND d.distance_km IS NOT NULL
    AND d.outside_temp_avg_c IS NOT NULL
    AND CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (d.distance_km) / 1.60934 ELSE (d.distance_km) END >= $min_distance
    AND d.$start_range - d.$end_range > 0.1
    AND d.start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT bucket AS "Outside temp (°$temp_unit)",
       ROUND(total_distance / NULLIF(total_range, 0), 3) AS "Efficiency",
       ROUND(total_range / NULLIF(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (total_distance) / 1.60934 ELSE (total_distance) END, 0) * (SELECT efficiency_wh_km FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1), 0) AS "Consumption (Wh/$length_unit)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (total_distance) / 1.60934 ELSE (total_distance) END, 1) AS "Driven ($length_unit)",
       ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN (total_distance) / 1.60934 ELSE (total_distance) END / NULLIF(duration, 0) * 60, 1) AS "Ø speed ($length_unit/h)"
FROM t
ORDER BY 1 DESC

targets.queryText:
SELECT ROUND(charge_energy_added_kwh
              / NULLIF(end_ideal_range_km - start_ideal_range_km, 0)
              / CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN 1.0 / 1.60934 ELSE 1 END, 3) * 1000 AS "efficiency_$length_unit",
       COUNT(*) AS "count"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE status = 'closed'
  AND (julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 1440 > 10
  AND end_battery_level <= 95
  AND start_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND end_ideal_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND charge_energy_added_kwh > 0
GROUP BY 1
HAVING "efficiency_$length_unit" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT 3
